memos.scout:
Case for buying (weak, and I would not buy on this brief):

The strongest point is the last 15 minutes: 186 buyers against 140 sellers, buy volume of 96.4 SOL versus 87.0 SOL sold, and a +19.9% return. That suggests fresh money is still arriving rather than only early holders exiting. Early-buyer concentration also looks moderate: the top 5 buyers hold about 28% of early flow, and there is no airdrop dump or factory pattern.

Against that: the coin is down 38% from its 30-minute high, and the first two minutes after graduation show sells roughly equal to buys (1.02), with a launch bot present. The curve fields (bundle share, top-3 share, completer share) are unresolved, so I can't tell whether this is operator-backed. The 15-minute rebound is also the kind of short bounce that often fades within the 30-60 minute window that matters here. The pool is thin at 82 SOL, which means a $20 round trip will carry a meaningful slice of the 1.4-5.1% cost. Name and symbol are null, so there is no story to lean on.

Verdict: no strong case. The recent bounce is real but short-lived by base rates, the structure is unresolved, and the pool is shallow. Skip.

Curve bundle and top3 data are null, so insider concentration can't be ruled out. Pass.
